page.layout: One printed page, one text block in the centre with a woodcut ornament band at the top; no running head, no page number, no margin notes. A library stamp at the left edge is not transcribed.

main_text.head: Nobilissimis & Pietate Illustrissimis, Dominabus, & Matronis,
main_text.p: Dn. BENIGNE DE SOMMEZE, viduæ defuncti Illustrissimi Consulis Domini POLIER, Susceptrici suæ e sacris fontibus, nunquam non honorandæ, & perpetuis officiis colendæ.
Dn. SUSANNE POLIER ejus filiæ, susceptrici suæ perpetuùm venerandæ, studiosè demer endæ.
main_text.head: UT ET
main_text.p: Dn. JOH. PET. POLIER, Domino in Botens, Rerumpublicarum Inspectori digniffimo, vigilantissimo, susceptori suo obsequiis usque ad aras prosequendo omnigenis.
main_text.head: NEC NON
main_text.p: Dn. GEORGIO POLIER Domino in Vernans, &c. Divini Verbi Pastori ut disertissimo, ita Meritissimo, vigilantissimo, studiorum meorum Promotori, omni honoris Cultu, & Reverentiæ observando.
Dn. SEBASTIANO LOYS Assessori Dignissimo, Lozoico Senatori Consultimo, omne in ævum colendo.

p.i: Dominis Mæcenatibus, Fautoribus, Promotoribus, hocce studiorum suorum specimen in debita ob-servantia Monumentum æternum

main_text.p: D. D. D. D. D. S.

page.notes: Library stamp at left edge and ink marks omitted. Some words in the dedication are set with irregular type and may be imperfectly read, notably "Botens" and "Vernans". Printed text is in the layout as a single block.
